If EXAMINATION could be given the code number 125, what code number can be given to HARDWORK?
questions.s:
The pattern followed here is:

According to the alphabetical positions of the letters,

EXAMINATION → E (5) + X (24) + A (1) + M (13) + I (9) + N (14) + A (1) + T (20) + I (9) + O (15) + N (14) = 5 + 24 + 1 + 13 + 9 + 14 + 1 + 20 + 9 + 15 + 14 = 125 

Similarly,

HARDWORK → H (8) + A (1) + R (18) + D (4) + W (23) + O (15) + R (18) + K (11) = 8 + 1 + 18 + 4 + 23 + 15 + 18 + 11 = 98

Hence, ‘98’ is the correct answer.
